issues.issue: Whether the applicants were given a reasonable opportunity to be heard before their claims were declared abandoned
issues.applicant_position: Did not know they had to appear at the February 3, 2014 special hearing; relied on consultant's advice.
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not respond to the application.
issues.result_quote: I find that the claimants were given a reasonable opportunity to be heard in regard to the abandonment of their claims

issues.issue: Whether the former consultant's mistaken advice on the filing deadline is a breach of natural justice
issues.applicant_position: Consultant advised them they had until March 2014 to file; they relied on that advice (affidavit).
issues.respondent_position: Minister did not respond to the application.
issues.result_quote: An applicant remains bound by the immigration consultant's conduct, as would be the case if she had retained legal counsel
